main_axis.headline: You are pushed forward by turning demands and ideas into work people can inspect.
main_axis.body: Eating God — output that flows naturally through craft and enjoyment — leads: you tend to make a usable result rather than leave an idea as talk. Companion — your own judgment, and peers who move with you — comes next, keeping your choices and peer coordination active. Direct Resource — systems, credentials, and backing — sits behind that as a quieter way to gather methods and support.
main_axis.evidence: Eating God carries weight 9: Xin appears on the month pillar stem, and the year Chou and day You hidden-stem tables also classify Eating God. Companion carries 8, from Ji on the hour pillar stem and the year Chou hidden-stem table. Direct Resource carries 6; both Si branches have hidden-stem tables that include Direct Resource. The visible characters show earth 3, metal 2, fire 2, wood 1, and water 0.

core_loop.headline: Hard demand → visible work → another demand.
core_loop.flow: When a hard demand arrives, you answer by making something concrete that can be judged. Once that result is accepted, you tend to move toward the next task.
core_loop.driver: The Ji earth Day Master is somewhat strong; metal, water, and wood are listed as favorable candidates. Eating God carries weight 9 and Seven Killings 5; the Wealth family totals 1.
core_loop.leak:
You can keep proving your usefulness through finished work while leaving the terms of steady return undefined.
The ten years starting around age 42 (the Bing Zi pillar) bring stronger water into view, making repeatable returns a more prominent question.
Before starting a task, write down what counts as accepted, who owns the next step, and how the finished work will be reused or paid for.
core_loop.evidence: Seven Killings carries weight 5 and appears as Yi on the year pillar stem. Eating God carries 9 and appears on the month pillar stem and in the year Chou and day You hidden-stem tables. The age-42 stretch is Bing Zi; Zi is a water branch. Visible water is 0, while Indirect Wealth carries 1 and Direct Wealth carries 0.

structure_type.name: the work-first responder
structure_type.one_line: You turn demands into tangible work, then rely on your own judgment to choose what to take on next.

capability_source.headline: Strongest when a hard brief needs a finished, demonstrable result; weakest when you must build steady returns from work over time.
capability_source.text: Your strongest scene comes from the chart's prominent craft-and-output drive, which turns hard demands into visible work. When a manager and a colleague bring you an unclear request before a review, you can draft a sample and walk them through it.
capability_source.evidence: Eating God carries weight 9 and appears on the month pillar stem and in the year Chou and day You hidden-stem tables; Seven Killings carries 5 and appears on the year pillar stem. The Wealth family totals 1: Indirect Wealth carries 1, while Direct Wealth carries 0.

structure_fingerprint: You answer demands by making work and use your own judgment to choose what comes next.
